title: Chunks in a sum or difference
note: Break at the + and − signs, keeping each sign with its term. Each product like 3x stays whole.

pitfalls.why: splitting 3x into 3 and x instead of keeping the product as one chunk

title: Chunks in a product
note: Break at the multiplication points. Each bracket is one factor.

title: Implicit chunking — multiplication precedence
note: There are no brackets, but multiplication binds tighter than +. Read the implicit chunks: 3x and 2y.

pitfalls.why: not reading the implicit multiplication that binds 3 and x into one chunk

title: Bracket as a single chunk
note: Resist expanding — treat the whole bracket as one object.

pitfalls.why: expanding the brackets instead of keeping each as one chunk
